items.text: trim a video you just recorded. In the viewer, trim shows a strip under the video: drag the start and end, it loops the part you keep, done makes that the file you save or share
while something animates, the tools button also sweeps an arc round a tool's icon, or, showing its three dots, lights them one after another
the running chain and the wave come from the shared kit now (canon for every CHAMY·XYZ tool); they look and behave the same

while anything in the tools is animating (a word sequence, a steer loop, a magnet loop) a ring keeps rippling out of the tools button; inside, the running chain marks which one, now also under the text shelf's sequence clock
in the tools drawer, a tool that is driving the animation right now (a word sequence, a steer loop, a magnet loop) has a running chain of dots under it, so you can see which one it is
on a phone the opening duck could come down twice. It now waits for the type to arrive and follows the cover's duck all the way, so it lands once, exactly where the duck is
Founders Club is written as a name everywhere: the cover, the sheet, the index and the messages
the sound and color panels' tabs come from the shared kit now, with the same icon-only threshold everywhere
report a bug names a person to write to, hi@chamy.xyz, for anyone who would rather send an email
